persona-vocabulary.title: Words we use
persona-vocabulary.subtitle: Call things what your business calls them: a Patient, a Client, a Member, a Visit. Only the labels people read change.
persona-vocabulary.saved: Saved. Menus and screens now use your words.
persona-vocabulary.conflict: Someone else changed these words while you were editing. The latest version is shown; make your change again.
persona-vocabulary.language: You are editing the words people see when the app is in {language}. Switch the app language to edit another one.
persona-vocabulary.labelsOnly: Only labels change. Your data, exports, integrations, API and the messages you send to customers keep their usual names.
persona-vocabulary.applyAll: Use these words in every language
persona-vocabulary.applyAllHint: Saves the same words for all 21 app languages. Leave it off to change only the language shown above.
persona-vocabulary.grammar: Words are placed in the app exactly as you type them. The app does not adjust grammar (gender, cases, articles) in other languages, and a few screens still say the standard word.
persona-vocabulary.sharedWord: In this language one word covers both appointments and meetings, so a new name for this one is not shown here. It still applies in other languages.

contact.hint: The people you talk to. Shown in the menu, the list, the record page and its buttons.

appointment.hint: A booked slot with a customer. Shown on the Appointments screen and on the contact record.

deal.hint: A sales opportunity. Shown on the Deals board and on the contact record.

meeting.hint: A call or meeting you log on a contact.

problems.incomplete: Fill in both the singular and the plural, or clear both.
problems.invalid: Use letters, numbers, spaces and - . & / ( ) only, up to 40 characters.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You need permission to manage workspace settings to change these words.
errors.conflict: These words changed while you were editing. Reload and try again.
errors.validation: One of the words is not allowed. Check the highlighted field.
errors.rateLimited: Too many changes in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
